newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLAND V AUSTRALIA 2ND 1-DAY INTERNATIONAL TOSS/TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND V AUSTRALIA 2ND 1-DAY INTERNATIONAL TOSS/TEAMS.

text.p: England captain Mike Atherton won the toss and put Australia in to bat in the second one-day international at The Oval on Saturday.
England - Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Graham Thorpe, Graham Lloyd, Adam Hollioake, Mark Ealham, Phil DeFreitas, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Ashley Giles.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Adam Gilchrist, Michael Slater, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Jason Gillepsie, Michael Kasprowicz, Glenn McGrath.
